feedback: Pre-race review, based only on earlier races. Iteration 2 (sensors at +/-0.06 m, weights +/-1.5 outer and +/-0.75 inner, kp 3.0, ki 0.3, kd 0.1, base_speed 1.4) is the best raced design at 40.38. It had line_loss_events 0 on all three tracks, down from 1 per run in iteration 1, so the wider span fixed the line loss. Every run still ended off_track (0 of 60 finished), with max_error 0.0609 to 0.0627 m, at or just above the 0.06 m limit. The oval had the highest steering_oscillation (0.112) and the widest score spread (31 to 167), which fits the 1.5x outer-weight scaling raising the effective outer gain from 3.0 to 4.5. The s-bend and slalom had low oscillation (0.064 to 0.067) with progress of only 0.04 and 0.035, so they are drifting, not jittering. This candidate changes one field, kp 3.0 to 2.5, which lowers the effective outer gain to 3.75. The arithmetic is correct, the geometry and every other controller field match the best raced design, and it is valid. It is a sound single-variable test and it fits the budget, so approve it for the race. The race is needed to see whether the lower gain reduces oscillation without losing steering authority. Do not treat the rationale's expected outcomes as measured. After the race, use the telemetry as follows. (a) If line_loss_events stays 0 and max_error is still at or above 0.06 with low oscillation on the s-bend and slalom, the drift is steady; raise ki toward 0.5 next. (b) If max_error falls below 0.06 with progress near 1 and completion_time above 3 s, raise base_speed to 1.7. (c) If max_error still reaches 0.06 with oval oscillation above about 0.09, the outer gain is still too high; do not lower kp further before testing kd. If kp 2.5 causes under-steering on the s-bend (progress falls or max_error grows as the robot runs), return kp to 3.0 and test ki instead. Change one group of fields per revision.
requested_changes: If the next race shows line_loss_events 0 with max_error still at or above 0.06 and low steering_oscillation on the s-bend and slalom (steady drift), set controller.ki from 0.3 to 0.5 and keep kp at 2.5, citing iteration 2's low s-bend and slalom oscillation (0.064 to 0.067).

If the next race shows line_loss_events 0, max_error below 0.06, and completion_time above 3 s with progress near 1, set controller.base_speed to 1.7 and keep the other fields, citing iteration 1's progress with only one line loss per run.

If the next race shows under-steering (progress falls or max_error grows on the s-bend relative to iteration 2's 0.0616), revert controller.kp to 3.0 and keep sensor_weights unchanged, citing iteration 2 as the best raced design.
